subject: Aligning POC slot with Horizon reforecast / exec travel
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara@horizon-analytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning POC slot with Horizon reforecast / exec travel

Hi Sara —

Following up from our call last week. We have a POC/demo slot we can hold for Horizon the week of May 17–21. I recall you mentioned the CFO will be on a roadshow and that finance is starting a reforecast; if that’s still the case, happy to be flexible.

Proposed: live 45-minute technical demo + 15-minute Q&A. We can tailor the agenda to focus on inference cost controls and multi-environment deployment (hosted -> dedicated -> private) — attached is a suggested agenda.

If the week of May 17 doesn’t work, could you confirm whether early June (week of June 7) is feasible after your internal budget gate? If you prefer, we’ll record a concise technical briefing now and book the live session for June.

Logistics note: we can also provide a short checklist for finance/infra teams to accelerate the procurement steps (PO, SOC 2 evidence, optional private deploy checklist).

Thanks —
Logan
Logan Wright
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0192
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Aligning POC slot with Horizon reforecast / exec travel

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the note and the agenda — looks useful. Quick update from our side: the CFO will be out of office for a two‑week roadshow beginning May 18 and finance is pushing a high‑level reforecast this month that may change our procurement cadence. We’d prefer to avoid scheduling a full live demo until the reforecast and an internal spend gate are complete.

Would you be able to:
- Share a 20–25 minute recorded technical briefing we can circulate to the execs and infra team?
- Hold the May 20 slot tentatively and move the live demo to the week of June 7 if the reforecast clears?

I cc’ed Tom (in infra) — he’ll review the checklist you mentioned.

Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Sara Kim
Director of Data Platform, Horizon Analytics
sara@horizon-analytics.com

Hi Sara —

Totally makes sense. We can do both: I’ll record a 20–25 minute technical briefing focused on cost levers (batching, quantization recommendations, routing policies) and the deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private) — compatible with the agenda I attached. Link to the recording will be shared by EOD Wednesday.

For the live demo, we’ll hold the May 20 slot tentatively and propose two firm options for the week of June 7:
- Tue, Jun 8 — 09:00–10:00 PT (technical + infra deep dive)
- Thu, Jun 10 — 13:00–14:00 PT (business + exec overview + tech breakouts)

If finance confirms the gate earlier, we can move the live session up. If not, we’ll keep the recording circulating so execs can review.

I’ve attached a quick checklist for horizon’s procurement/infra team to help accelerate the PO + KMS questions (horizon-budget-prereqs.xlsx). If Tom can confirm which artifacts his team needs from our side, we’ll prioritize those in the packet.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

— Logan
